title: KCP governance_disable result (greenfield-saga §4)
description: CommandResult.result payload for governance_disable (§11.2 ok arm). The frozen owner binding — its owner arm retained for audit — and the voided realm binding.

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256/HMAC value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

class.description: Family digest class (byom family-vectors PROFILE §6, D-R0-1). Governed-work host records use scope_erasure_safe: one protected per-realm governance key, so destroying it erases verifiability of the whole governance scope, never one row.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed family DigestRef (PROFILE §6.1), never an unlabelled hash. The class/algorithm pairing and the key_ref-presence rule for the keyed classes are enforced in code (they are a cross-member constraint the closed object cannot express here).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

selector.description: Kovee governed-scope selector, at most 256 visible-ASCII bytes. byom pins only this bounded opaque wire shape (C2 host schemas); the grammar (realm | project:<id|*>[/space:<id|*>]) and the overlap predicate of byom §16.6 item 1 are Kovee-owned and live in kovee_byom::scope.

compatibility_bundle.description: Compatibility is one explicit, all-or-nothing feature bundle (byom §16.6); a new bundle is a new schema version.

status.description: Kovee-owned status value set closing the recorded byom §16.6 gap: pending before the owner CAS (durable but NOT authoritative), active atomically with it, void after a rollback or a governed disable.

dependency_digest.description: Digest over the frozen governance_enable authorization dependency set (family contract §2.A).

koveeRealmByomBinding.description: KoveeRealmByomBinding, field list verbatim from byom §16.6 (byom/spec/governed-work/kovee-realm-byom-binding.schema.json).

exact_scope_digest.description: Canonical digest of the exact governed scope; UNIQUE(realm_ref, exact_scope_digest) and the no-overlapping-active-selectors rule are enforced in code, not expressible here.

revision.description: CAS field: the owner transition commits only at the expected revision.

binding_epoch.description: CAS field: the enablement epoch fence. A rolled-back epoch can never activate.

governance_owner.description: The owner enum, byom §16.6 as narrowed by byom amendment A9: byom owns the scope, or nothing does. There is no third owner.

cutover_ref.description: Present only on a byom §25 GovernanceCutover row; the greenfield saga never sets it.

status.description: Closed byom §16.6 enum. governance_disable freezes the row (active→frozen) with the owner arm retained for audit.

koveeGovernanceOwnerBinding.description: KoveeGovernanceOwnerBinding, field list verbatim from byom §16.6 with the owner enum narrowed to byom|none (byom amendment A9; kovee-governance-owner-binding-v2.schema.json). The owner-arm rule (governance_owner none carries no owner refs; byom names both) is a cross-member constraint enforced in code.
